question: 6. Does ____________ point with one finger to ask for something or to get help?

ask_no_followup.text: If there is something your child wants that is out of reach, such as a snack or toy that is out of reach, how does he/she get it? (If parent does not give a 0 example below, ask each individually.)

items: Reach for the object with his/her whole hand?
Try to get the object for him/herself?
Ask for it using words or sounds?

show_me_prompt.text: If you said "Show me," would he/she point at it?
